questions.q: The fixo is hiding. Tap where the fixo goes on a parallel run.
questions.explain: Yes. A parallel run goes straight down the same side as the ball.
choiceExplanations: Yes. A parallel run goes straight down the same side as the ball.
Cutting across into the middle is the diagonal run, not the parallel one.
Staying back is not a run, so the ala has nobody ahead to find.

questions.q: The side route gets closed. Put these moments in order, first to last.
options: Runner cuts in on a diagonal
questions.explain: Yes. The fixo passes left and runs first, so the ala has a runner to find.
choiceExplanations: Yes. The fixo passes left and runs first, so the ala has a runner to find.
The ala can only pass down the side once the fixo is running there.
The defender closes the side route after the first pass goes down it.
The diagonal comes last, once the side route is closed.

questions.q: On the right, the defender closes the side route. Drag the fixo somewhere open.
questions.explain: Yes. The diagonal run goes inside, away from the defender, so the lane is open.
choiceExplanations: The defender is closing that side route, so a pass there gets cut out.
Yes. The diagonal run goes inside, away from the defender, so the lane is open.
Standing still gives the right ala no new option while the defender presses.
